ingredients.name: Very Hot Water
ingredients.originalText: 2 cups Very Hot Water (or as directed)

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 2 cups Cracked Wheat (bulghur); 2 cups Very Hot Water (or as directed); 1 Cucumber, chopped; 2 small Tomatoes, chopped; 1 bunch Green Onions, sliced; 1/2 cup Mint (fresh), chopped; 2 cup Parsley (fresh), chopped; 1 clove Garlic, minced; 1/2 cup Lemon Juice (fresh); 3/4 cup Olive Oil; 1 Tbsp Pepper; 2 tsp Salt. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Prepare these ingredients before cooking: Cucumber: chopped; Tomatoes: small; chopped; Green Onions: sliced; Mint: chopped; fresh; Parsley: chopped; fresh; Garlic: minced. Wash produce under running water before cutting. Use a cutting board and a sharp knife; keep raw meat and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat ingredients.
Soak the cracked wheat in the hot water until the water is absorbed, about 30 minutes.
Drain any excess water, if necessary, and squeeze dry.
Combine the salad ingredients (all but the oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper dressing ingredients) in a medium bowl.
Mix the dressing ingredients together and stir into the salad mix
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Joel Maxuel
